name: Integrations / Workflow Connector Runtime
purpose: Connect backend commands to external workers and providers without allowing integrations to become the business brain.
locked_doctrine: Backend remains the controller and source of truth.
n8n workflows are stateless thin workers.
Each workflow may perform one Airtable mirror write and one backend result POST.
No orchestration logic is allowed inside n8n, Airtable, Playwright, PayFast, email, or other connectors.
Every inbound webhook must be authenticated or blocked.
Every workflow result must pass idempotency, state transition, policy gate, and evidence checks.
Playwright is scout/probe only and must route CAPTCHA, OTP, down portal, or blocked portal to MAP/manual fallback.
Airtable is mirror only and may not override PostgreSQL truth.
PayFast events update payment evidence but do not decide refunds without governance.
Email is the primary communications connector.
Connector failures must go to retry or DLQ with cause, reason, fix path, and evidence.
No secret values may be committed.
